summary: The directory test checks whether a path is an existing directory on the controller, not the target.
questions: How do I check if a local directory exists on the control node?
Does the directory test check the remote host?

answer_card.title: directory test (controller paths)
answer_card.answer_md: `path is directory` is true if the path is an existing directory on the **controller** (localhost), not on managed hosts. Use `stat` for remote paths.
